name: escalate_to_pediatric_er
description: Escalate pediatric patient to the pediatric emergency department for age-appropriate emergency care

vital_signs_abnormal.description: Whether vital signs are outside normal range for age

parent_present.description: Whether parent or guardian is present

when_to_use: Infant with febrile seizure or suspected meningitis
Child with severe respiratory distress or croup
Pediatric trauma patient requiring specialized assessment
Suspected child abuse or non-accidental injury
Pediatric patient with signs of sepsis or septic shock

examples.query: 6-month-old with high fever, lethargy, and bulging fontanelle

args.presenting_complaint: fever with lethargy and bulging fontanelle

examples.query: 3-year-old fell from second story window, alert but crying
